newsitem.title: USA: 3M says China highway products project under way.
newsitem.headline: 3M says China highway products project under way.

text.p: Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co said on Friday afternoon its plan to build a plant in China to make highway safety products got early today.
"They had a groundbreaking cermeony ... in Xin Qiao, near Shanghai," said 3M spokesman Chris Welsh of the traditional Chinese ceremony for the 33-acre site. "The deal's done."
Earlier on Friday, he had said the St Paul, Minn.-based company was close to finalizing the deal.
Welsh declined to specify how much the new factory would cost but said this project brings 3M's total investment in China to more than $60 million over a 12-year period.
The new facility will make reflective sheeting used in products such as traffic signs and license plates.
The plant could be on-line in 1998, he added.
